verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV docs clearly document a webhook subscription system with selectable event types (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) delivering real-time alerts, matching the story's ask. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability or delivery guarantees, and no detail on subscription management (e.g., filtering, retries, or programmatic subscription API) beyond event type selection.
